title: Grok 4.5
summary: Grok 4.5 is now available in Conductor! We've also added Cursor's Auto model.

hero.alt: Auto and Cursor Grok 4.5 in the Cursor model picker

html:
Grok 4.5 is now available in Conductor! We've also added Cursor's Auto model.

To use Grok 4.5, set up Cursor in Settings → Harnesses → Cursor, then pick it from the model picker in any chat.
markdown:
![Auto and Cursor Grok 4.5 in the Cursor model picker](/assets/changelog/images/grok-4.5-0.73.2.png)

Grok 4.5 is now available in Conductor! We've also added Cursor's Auto model.

To use Grok 4.5, set up Cursor in Settings → Harnesses → Cursor, then pick it from the model picker in any chat.
